subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should OpenClaw expose pending exec approval command details through the CLI now, and if so should the first merge be list/json only or include resolve/watch behavior?
rationale: The backend API exists, but making command text and approval actions available from the CLI is an operator security boundary and product-scope choice rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Ship list/json first
options.body: Expose only pending approval inspection through the existing `exec.approval.list` RPC, preserving current authorization and leaving watch/resolve for separate review.

options.title: Adopt broader CLI control
options.body: Land pending/list plus resolve/respond after the candidate PR proves the live gateway path and security semantics.

options.title: Defer CLI surface
options.body: Keep pending approval inspection in UI/SDK paths until maintainers decide CLI command exposure is worth the operator-risk tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Ship list/json first
recommendation.body: Expose only pending approval inspection through the existing `exec.approval.list` RPC, preserving current authorization and leaving watch/resolve for separate review.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the approvals CLI/docs surface and already scoped the remaining CLI work in the issue discussion.
